title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and clean up deps/hygiene
author: Aisha Malik
description: Unify and simplify CI workflows across the monorepo: consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade GitHub Actions and Node versions, improve cache/parallelism usage, and remove legacy per-repo pipelines. Motivation: reduce CI maintenance, speed up PR feedback, and standardize release automation. This change consolidates three workflow files into .github/workflows/ci.yml with matrixed jobs for lint/test/release; upgrades actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 and uses Node 20 LTS defaults; normalizes caching keys and reduces duplicate restore steps to improve cache hit rate; introduces prioritized parallelism control for heavy e2e jobs to reduce queueing; applies ESLint auto-fixes across the monorepo and updates TypeScript/TSLint dependencies to align with workspace constraints; removes deprecated release scripts and replaces them with a release-automation job that delegates to the release-bot. Checklist: [x] run full CI locally; [x] smoke deploy to staging; [x] coordinate with Platform (ENG-2345) for rollout; [x] update developer docs. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; release scripts replaced with automated job that keeps existing release tags and changelog behavior. Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor ci/failure-rate and cache-hit metrics, enable release-automation gating over 48h. See linked Linear ENG-2345 for rollout and rollback playbook.
commits_summary: b4a1f2c: consolidate multiple workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint/test/release matrix)
d3e4f5a: bump actions/setup-node to v4 and standardize on node 20 for runners
e6f7a8b: normalize cache keys, remove duplicate restore steps, improve cache hit rate
f9g0h1i: apply eslint --fix across packages and update ESLint/TS deps to workspace-aligned versions
a1b2c3d: replace legacy scripts with release-automation job that calls release-bot; add gating and audit hooks
patch_snippets: key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-${{ matrix.node-version }} -> normalized cache key and fewer restores

strategy:
  matrix:
    node-version: [20]
    include: [{ name: "lint", job: "lint" }] -> simplified matrix to avoid repeated installs
release job: run: ./tools/release-bot/trigger.sh -> replaced legacy script with release-bot integration and audit hooks
review_discussion: Carlos: Can we keep node 18 in the matrix for one more cycle to give customers time to upgrade? — Aisha: We kept a short compatibility job in the matrix that runs node 18 for nightly but removed it from PR-level matrix to speed feedback.
Diane: E2E jobs flaked in the canary run, root cause? — Aisha: Flakes were due to cold caches; normalized cache keys and added a warm-cache pre-step for e2e which reduced observed flakes in staging.

Evan: Any risk to release automation replacing scripts? — Aisha: Release-bot preserves the tag and changelog behavior; added an audit log step and feature flag 'release-automation.enabled' to gate rollout.
Diane (approval): LGTM after cache key doc update and one successful staging release. — Aisha: Addressed and added docs/ci.md changes in the final commit.
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky on first run -> re-run passed
merge_commit_message: refactor(ci): unify CI workflows, upgrade actions & node, normalize cache keys, and replace legacy release scripts with release-bot (ENG-2345)
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into a single .github/workflows/ci.yml; upgraded GitHub Actions and standardized on Node 20; improved cache keys and parallelism to reduce CI queueing; replaced legacy release scripts with release-bot; applied ESLint auto-fixes and dependency alignment across packages. No breaking changes expected.
notes_for_ops: Monitor metric: ci.failure_rate and infra.ci.cache_hit_rate for 72h post-merge. Gate release-automation via feature flag; revert timeline documented in ENG-2345 playbook. If e2e queueing recurs, reduce concurrency for heavy jobs via strategy.max-parallelism.
